def VTask.replaceVertex {V : Type u_1} (G : SimpleGraph V) (s t : V) [DecidableEq V] : SimpleGraph V :=
  let adj (v w : V) : Prop :=
    if v = t then
      if w = t then
        False
      else
        G.Adj s w
    else if w = t then
      G.Adj s v
    else
      G.Adj v w
  let symm_iff (v w : V) : adj v w ↔ adj w v :=
    by
      cases (Decidable.decEq v t) with (hv_eq : v = t) (hv_ne : v ≠ t)
      · cases (Decidable.decEq w t) with (hw_eq : w = t) (hw_ne : w ≠ t)
        · simp [adj, hv_eq, hw_eq]
          rfl
        · simp [adj, hv_eq, hw_ne]
          rfl
      · cases (Decidable.decEq w t) with (hw_eq : w = t) (hw_ne : w ≠ t)
        · simp [adj, hv_ne, hw_eq]
          rfl
        · simp [adj, hv_ne, hw_ne]
          exact G.symm v w
  let loopless (v : V) : ¬ adj v v :=
    by
      cases (Decidable.decEq v t) with (hv_eq : v = t) (hv_ne : v ≠ t)
      · simp [adj, hv_eq]
        intro h
        exact False.elim h
      · simp [adj, hv_ne]
        exact G.loopless v
  let symm_proof : ∀ {v w}, adj v w → adj w v :=
    λ h => (symm_iff v w).mpr h
  { Adj := adj,
    symm := symm_proof,
    loopless := loopless }
